title: An enlarging pigmented lesion of the bilateral hard palatal mucosa
html: An 84-year-old woman came to our oral medicine and oral oncology clinic for evaluation of a pigmented lesion of the bilateral palatal mucosa (Figure 1) that had increased in size over the prior 3 months. At the time of consultation, she reported the right hard palatal mucosa as having had a stable pigmented lesion for 11 years. After the initial discovery at that time by her dentist, a biopsy by her otolaryngologist showed a melanotic macule, although no photos or descriptive records of the lesion from this period were provided.
